This role will serve as the owner's representative responsible for leading facility planning, programming, design development, and project delivery for manufacturing, engineering, laboratory, office, and secure facility projects.
This position is heavily focused on design management and will be responsible for directing external architecture and engineering (A&E) firms throughout the entire project lifecycle.

The successful candidate will lead stakeholder engagement, requirements development, programming, consultant management, design reviews, constructability reviews, and technical decision-making while ensuring designs align with operational objectives, budget constraints, schedule requirements, security requirements, and long-term facility strategies.
The ideal candidate thrives in environments where requirements are evolving and can effectively guide design teams through ambiguity to produce practical, constructible, and scalable solutions. Construction oversight is expected, but the primary focus of this role is ensuring design quality, design coordination, and successful project definition before construction begins.
The initial assignment will be the planning, design, and delivery of a prototype laboratory facility supporting advanced engineering and development activities.

Serve as the owner's lead representative for facility planning, programming, and design execution.
Manage and direct architecture, engineering, specialty consultant, and design-build teams.
Develop project requirements in partnership with engineering, manufacturing, operations, security, and executive stakeholders.
Convert high-level business and operational objectives into actionable facility and infrastructure requirements.
Lead programming efforts, space planning exercises, feasibility studies, and conceptual design development.
Oversee design development from concept through construction documents.
Establish and manage design schedules, consultant deliverables, review cycles, and design budgets.
Lead design review meetings and drive resolution of technical issues, scope gaps, and coordination conflicts.
Review architectural, civil, structural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire protection, and specialty system designs.
Evaluate designs for constructability, maintainability, operational efficiency, scalability, safety, and lifecycle performance.
Ensure designs support manufacturing operations, engineering workflows, laboratory functions, airfield activities, and secure facility requirements.
Coordinate internal stakeholder reviews and ensure project requirements are properly incorporated into design documents.
Support permitting, entitlement, and regulatory approval efforts.
Provide technical leadership during procurement, contractor selection, and project execution activities.
Manage design-related RFIs, submittals, field modifications, and consultant support during construction.
Utilize AutoCAD to review, coordinate, and comment on design documentation.
Serve as the primary interface between internal stakeholders and external design consultants.

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, or related technical field.
Minimum 10 years of experience in design management, owner's representation, architecture, engineering, facilities development, or capital project delivery.
Demonstrated experience managing architecture and engineering firms on complex facility projects.
Strong understanding of facility planning, programming, design development, and construction documentation.
Experience leading multidisciplinary design teams through all phases of project development.
Ability to review and interpret architectural and engineering drawings, specifications, calculations, and technical documentation.
Working knowledge of building systems, construction methods, codes, and industry best practices.
Proficiency with AutoCAD.
Experience supporting projects in active operational environments, including aviation or airfield facilities.
Strong stakeholder management, communication, and decision-making skills.
Ability to work effectively in situations with incomplete or evolving requirements.
Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. SECRET Security Clearance.
Ability to lift 50 pounds or greater and perform site visits in active construction environments.

Active U.S. SECRET Security Clearance or higher.
Experience supporting advanced manufacturing, aerospace, defense, or technology environments.
Experience planning and designing laboratories, prototype development spaces, engineering facilities, or manufacturing operations.
Familiarity with ICD 705 requirements and secure facility design.
Experience with SCIF planning, design, and accreditation processes.
Experience delivering projects using design-build, progressive design-build, or fast-track delivery methods.
Professional registration or certification such as PE, RA, PMP, CCM, LEED, or similar.
Experience managing mission-critical or highly technical facilities.

The Social Creative Director will lead the creative vision for Spotify's global social presence, ensuring every piece of content is visually compelling, culturally relevant, and unmistakably Spotify. Working across Brand, Product, Music, Podcasts, Audiobooks, and Fitness, you'll help shape how millions of fans experience Spotify every day through innovative storytelling and world-class creative.
As a creative leader, you'll inspire and develop a high-performing team while partnering closely with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver work that pushes creative boundaries and strengthens Spotify's position as a leader in social storytelling.

Lead the creative vision for Spotify's global social channels, delivering innovative, high-quality storytelling that strengthens the brand across Brand, Product, Music, Podcasts, Audiobooks, and Fitness.
Partner with cross-functional teams (including Social Strategy, Brand, Project Management, and agency partners) to develop and deliver social-first campaigns from concept through execution.
Lead, mentor, and inspire a team of creatives, fostering a collaborative, inclusive environment and ensuring creative excellence across every project.
Champion consistency by maintaining Spotify's social brand guidelines, developing scalable creative toolkits, and partnering with regional teams to deliver a cohesive global social presence.
Stay ahead of emerging social trends, platform capabilities, and audience behaviors, while confidently presenting creative work and recommendations to senior leadership.

You have at least 10+ years of creative leadership experience in entertainment, technology, media, or consumer brands, with a strong portfolio of social-first work.
You have deep expertise in social platforms, content formats, and creative best practices, and know how to turn strategy into engaging, culturally relevant storytelling.
You are an experienced people leader who builds strong partnerships, communicates with influence, and thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
You care deeply about creative quality, bring a solutions-oriented mindset, and inspire teams to produce work that pushes creative boundaries while delivering meaningful business impact.

Where You'll Be

This role can be based in New York or Los Angeles.
We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.
We ask that you come in 1-2 times per week.

At AKQA, we believe in the imaginative application of art and science to create a better future. With an entrepreneurial and collaborative approach, we design adaptive ideas, services and experiences that capture the imagination, delivering impressive returns for our clients.
Creatives at AKQA apply artistry and craftsmanship to strategic insight to craft beautiful brands, products, campaigns and experiences that stop people in their tracks. Skilled storytellers, they work in a multidisciplinary environment to unlock new value for our clients.
As an Art Director in Beirut, you’ll play an essential role in the strategy, conception and design of beautiful ideas, experiences, products and more. You’ll use your exceptional creative thought and craft skills to produce transformative work for regional and global clients, working with a team of multidisciplinary creatives within the studio and across the network.
At AKQA you will have access to world-renowned thought leadership from influential authors, athletes, artists and entrepreneurs. You will work in an environment which fosters a meritocratic culture and encourages ownership, and you will be surrounded by some of the brightest minds in their fields.

Lead with creative hunger. Drive concepts, visuals, and design systems with the energy of a maker and the ambition of a leader, pushing every idea to be braver, sharper, and more culturally relevant.
Be a storyteller with taste. Shape narratives through visuals, composition, rhythm, and emotion, not just decoration. Every frame, layout, and edit must convey intention, story, and meaning.
Craft with obsession. Whether it's a platform identity, a film, a digital experience, a product UI, or a prototype, treat details like a signature. Your work should feel unmistakably world-class.
Think beyond the screen. Build ideas that live as acts, installations, products, content ecosystems, and tech-enabled experiences, not just campaigns. Bring innovation and experimentation into the room naturally.
Make ideas PR-able by design. Create visuals and concepts that earn cultural attention, not just meet a brief. Understand what travels regionally and globally, and design for impact.
Own the process end-to-end. From early sketches to motion tests to production supervision, push the idea through every phase. Know when to be hands-on and when to lead from altitude.
Collaborate like a modern creative. Work fluidly with writers, strategists, technologists, designers, makers, AI systems, and the broader AKQA network. Seek friction that makes the work stronger.
Elevate the room. Bring energy, references, inspiration, and ideas that push the team forward. Mentor juniors, shape thinking, and help raise the studio's creative temperature.
Challenge the brief, respectfully. Ask the questions others don't. Find the tension, expose the opportunity, and push for the version of the work that truly moves people.
Present with creative conviction. Show work with clarity, story, and craft, helping clients feel the ambition, vision, and emotional intent behind each idea.
Guard the quality. Be accountable for every output. Ensure every visual, layout, prototype, and film frame meets AKQA's global standards and reflects the studio's ambition.

You have a compelling portfolio of work that demonstrates high-quality art direction and concepting across a variety of projects.
Proven creative success working in collaborative, multi-functional teams.
Strong information presentation skills, visual and written.
You have a breadth of cultural reference points.
You have a drive to break boundaries and craft the best ideas of their kind in the world.
You are passionate, driven and obsessed about your craft and stay on top of best practice in your field.
Experience in leading a team and working directly with clients is advantageous.
A degree in Design, Interaction Design, Visual Studies or other design-related field preferred.
Extensive experience using the most common software.
Experience of nurturing client relationships.
Appreciated supplementary skills include a passion for photography, 3D modelling and/or digital installations
We believe great work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach including required in-office days. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

About WPP
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com .

The Creative team at AKQA (part of WPP) applies artistry and craftsmanship to strategic insight, bringing to life beautiful and technologically innovative ideas that move the world. From a variety of backgrounds and disciplines, our creatives are innately curious and strive to transform client challenges into groundbreaking, design-led solutions.
As an Associate Creative Director (Art/Design) in our Amsterdam studio, you’ll inspire and lead a team to craft visually striking concepts and executions across CGI, motion design, and interactive media.

With a foundation in art direction and deep expertise in production, you will direct specialized CGI artists and guide cross-disciplinary teams to create cinematic, technically precise, and emotionally-resonant work.

From large-scale digital platforms and motion-led brand systems, to experimental storytelling powered by emerging tools, you’ll push the boundaries of what’s possible in digital creativity.
You’re a visionary creative leader who thinks like a filmmaker, builds like a technician, and creates like a storyteller, bringing together craft, innovation, and strategy to shape work that influences culture and elevates global brands.
As part of the AKQA team and based in our Amsterdam studio, you’ll work in an environment that fosters a dynamic and inclusive culture, enabled by our multidisciplinary approach and supported by some of the brightest minds in their field. You will report to the Creative Director and collaborate closely with team leads across the studio to continually inspire, innovate, and deliver work of the highest standard.

Deliver and lead award-winning work that meets client needs while influencing culture, blending art direction, design craft, and innovative use of technology.
Direct and Lead autonomous teams to bring cinematic vision, technical precision, and emotional storytelling into every project — thinking like a filmmaker, building like a technician, and creating like a storyteller.
Establish and direct creative foundations in concepting art directions for production and motion graphics, ensuring ideas are strategically sound and visually compelling.
Ability to direct specialised CGI artists across animation, modelling, rigging, lighting, and compositing to maintain creative cohesion and quality.
Apply craft knowledge across CGI workflows, including modelling, lighting, animatics, grading, and retouching.
Provide hands-on expertise in retouching, compositing, grading, and finalising large-scale projects, guiding teams through complex production pipelines.
Implement advanced workflows such as EXR and ACES to ensure colour accuracy, consistency, and creative control.
Contribute to and lead the development of creative briefs, collaborating with clients and strategists to define opportunities and deliver visionary outcomes.
Collaborate across disciplines — including design, UX, and development — to integrate creativity, craft, and strategy seamlessly into final outputs.
Creatively lead new business pitches, presenting ideas and executions with confidence and clarity to global clients.
Explore and implement AI-assisted workflows (e.g., ComfyUI with open-source models, LoRa training, Google partnerships) to push creative boundaries.
Demonstrate proficiency in editing (Adobe Premiere, After Effects), motion retouching (DaVinci), and emerging AI generation tools.

Proven experience at Associate Creative Director level or in a comparable art/design hybrid leadership role, with a strong background in both concepting and execution.
A demonstrated track record of leading award-winning creative work across European and global markets, showcasing the ability to deliver at scale and on an international stage.
You have experience with AI production using state of the art models, knowing the pros and cons of each and what model to use, when to use what, and how to use each through JSON-based prompting - and how to put different outputs together.
Strong foundation in art direction and motion graphics, coupled with advanced CGI production knowledge across the full pipeline, from modeling to post-production.
Hands-on craft expertise in compositing, grading, retouching, and finishing, with the ability to dive into details and elevate the final quality of work.
Sharp eye for art direction, visual storytelling, and design excellence, ensuring all work meets the highest aesthetic and conceptual standards.
Experienced in building and maintaining client relationships, growing partnerships through trust, creativity, and consistent delivery of exceptional results.
Exceptional communicator with the ability to craft and deliver compelling presentations, clearly articulating creative vision, rationale, and executional guidelines.
Recognised for representing your agency publicly—through talks, mentorship, or thought leadership—and inspiring both peers and the next generation of creatives.

At AKQA (part of WPP), we believe in the imaginative application of art and science to design a better future. Our Product Design Directors craft the interfaces, systems, and experiences that define how brands behave in the modern world, across mobile, spatial, voice, wearables, and AI-powered environments.
As a Product Design Director, you’ll lead the design of products and brand experiences for some of the world’s most influential organisations, from luxury ecosystems and cultural platforms to next-generation mobility and wellness systems. You’ll guide multi-disciplinary teams to create elegant, human-centred design solutions that are as intelligent as they are inspiring.
You’ll define design direction across a portfolio of complex, high-impact digital products, establishing benchmarks in accessibility, interaction, and multi-modal experience. You’ll champion the new frontier of brand user interfaces: adaptive design languages that translate brand identity into behaviour, sound, motion, and intelligence.
AKQA Product Design Directors operate at the intersection of brand, craft, and computation, working side-by-side with strategy, data, and engineering teams to shape products that learn, evolve, and earn love over time.
This is a leadership role within AKQA’s London studio, part of a globally connected studio network shaping the future of digital experiences for brands including Nike, Rolls-Royce, Samsung, Airbnb, and Google. You’ll be at the forefront of AI-powered product design, helping redefine how creativity, intelligence, and empathy coexist in every interaction.

Lead concept, design, and delivery of world-class digital products and connected experiences that define new standards for creativity and usability.
Partner with UX, Creative Technology, and AI Engineering teams to shape AI-native interfaces, generative UI systems, and adaptive design components.
Establish and evolve brand-led design systems that perform across screen, voice, gesture, and spatial interfaces.
Embed accessibility and inclusivity from first principles, ensuring WCAG compliance and usability for all audiences.
Drive experimentation across new modalities: voice and audio UX, wearable ecosystems, computer vision, and mixed reality.
Mentor, grow, and inspire a diverse team of product designers, cultivating craftsmanship, critical thinking, and innovation.
Collaborate closely with strategists and client partners to translate brand purpose into tangible, useful digital products.
Represent AKQA in new business opportunities, articulating the value of design in solving complex business and human challenges.
Contribute to AKQA’s global culture of learning, sharing insights on design ethics, AI co-creation, and emerging interaction paradigms.

10+ years’ experience (as a guide, not a restriction) in product design or interaction design at leading studios or in-house teams.
Proven leadership in delivering large-scale, multi-platform digital products from concept to launch.
Mastery of Figma and contemporary design-system workflows (tokens, auto-layout, component libraries), along with complementary tools such as code-based interaction design software and no-code web/app solutions.
Strong understanding of human-centred design, accessibility, motion, and micro-interaction principles.
Familiarity with AI design tools, prototyping in Framer, Principle, ProtoPie, or After Effects, and collaboration with machine-learning or data-science teams.
Demonstrable success in uniting brand and product through interface design, e.g. motion language, sound design, or spatial storytelling.
Experience mentoring mid- and senior-level designers; a track record of growing creative excellence and cultural impact.
Comfortable presenting to senior clients and executives, and confident operating within fast-paced, high-stakes environments.
Systems thinker with a deep sensitivity to brand and narrative.
Calm, credible communicator who brings clarity and optimism to complex challenges.
Obsessed with emerging technologies and their human potential.
Advocate for inclusive design and accessible innovation.
Balances bold vision with precision in craft.
Please include your portfolio link and examples of your work in your application. We are not able to accept applications that do not include a link to your work.

DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention services across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Meta, eBay, and OpenAI. We have been certified B Corp and Climate Neutral since 2021.

This role is part of our Marketing team based in Berlin. You’ll work with a vibrant mix of talents, ranging from Brand Strategists, Creatives, Designers, Social Experts and Influencer Marketers to Account managers and Producers. As a digital creative marketing agency, we mix traditional storytelling with the best of what today’s technology has to offer to deliver exceptional and engaging digital experiences that build lasting relationships with our clients.
We’re looking for a talented and strategic Art Director to join fast-paced, high-performing, and most visible dynamic accounts. This is a hands-on role for someone who brings conceptual thinking, sharp visual design capabilities, and video-first experience to the table. Someone who can translate strategy into smart, engaging creative that hooks niche audiences.
You’ll partner closely with a team of Copywriters, Video Editors, Content Creators, Visual Designers and report into the Creative Director, collaborating to bring creative briefs to life across digital, social, and video channels. You’ll help shape always-on social and campaign direction, lead visual execution, and ensure design excellence from kickoff through delivery. You’ll play a crucial role in owning your workstream and consistently raising the creative bar.
This role is perfect for someone who thrives in creative collaboration, is autonomous in ideation, enjoys rolling up their sleeves to execute, and has a strong point of view on what makes effective content in the digital world.

Concept and design best-in-class digital creative across social and video, with a strong focus on visual storytelling and performance.
Contribute to pre-production planning, support on-set shoots, and collaborate with editors and designers in post to ensure work comes to life as intended.
Work closely with copywriters, strategists, producers, project managers, and client teams to ensure creative aligns with brief goals, brand voice, and business objectives.
Navigate ambiguity with CD support, adapt to shifting priorities, and bring proactive solutions to creative and production challenges. These solutions should come in the form of daily brainstorming and inspiration sharing with the team.
Approach every situation with curiosity, kindness, and accountability to help foster an inclusive and collaborative team environment.

4+ years of experience in visual design with a strong portfolio showcasing digital campaigns, social-first content, and video-driven work.
Native German with excellent English skills, capable of working with German and international brands.
Prior agency experience or relevant experience with a track record of navigating high-volume, high-visibility accounts.
On-set and content production experience (domestic or international), including working with video directors, editors, and producers.
Strong client presentation and communication skills - you can confidently present ideas, take feedback in stride, and advocate for great creative.
Excellent design sensibility and a strategic eye for layout, typography, motion, and branding. Additionally, deep knowledge of social best practices for optimal performance.
A proactive, collaborative mindset - you bring energy to brainstorms, jump in where needed, and support your teammates with generosity and respect.
A creative portfolio that shows your eye for design, your range in digital, video, and your ability to turn strategy into scroll-stopping creative.
You don’t just talk about AI—you use it. You have a proven track record of incorporating AI tools into your workflow to solve creative problems.

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.
We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.
At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

We’re looking for a talented and strategic Principal, Art Direction to join a fast-paced, high-performing team supporting one of our most visible, dynamic clients. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who brings conceptual thinking, sharp visual design capabilities, and video-first experience to the table.
As a key leader within the creative department, you will not only translate strategy into smart, engaging creative but also mentor a multidisciplinary team of designers and creators. You’ll partner closely with Copywriters, Video Editors, and Content Creators, reporting to the Creative Director to ensure design excellence from kickoff through delivery. You’ll play a crucial role in owning your workstream, managing junior talent, and consistently raising the creative bar.
This role is perfect for someone who thrives in creative collaboration, is autonomous in ideation, enjoys rolling up their sleeves to execute, and has a strong point of view on what makes effective content in the digital world.

Deliver High-Impact Creative: Concept and design best-in-class digital creative across social, and video, with a strong focus on visual storytelling and performance.
Mentor & Lead: Act as a direct supervisor and mentor to junior and mid-level Art Directors and Designers. Provide clear, constructive feedback to creatives across disciplines (for example, to copy) to elevate the team's output and foster professional growth.
Support Video + Content Production: Contribute to pre-production planning, support on-set shoots, and collaborate with editors and designers in post to ensure work comes to life as intended.
Partner Across Disciplines: Work closely with copywriters, strategists, producers, project managers, and client teams to ensure creative aligns with brief goals, brand voice, and business objectives.
Manage Creative Execution: Own the work from end to end. Concepting and producing polished on-brand, performance-minded assets that meet timelines and briefs. As an Associate Director, Art Direction, you will lead by doing, driving execution while strategically delegating portions of our projects to our junior team members to support efficiency, mentorship and delivery while remaining accountable for the final output.
Be a Problem Solver: Navigate ambiguity with CD support, adapt to shifting priorities, and bring proactive solutions to creative and production challenges. These solutions should come in the form of daily brainstorming and inspiration sharing with the team.
Cultivate Culture: Foster an inclusive, high-energy environment. Lead daily brainstorms and inspiration-sharing sessions to keep the team’s creative pulse sharp.

5+ years of experience in visual design with a strong portfolio showcasing digital campaigns, social-first content, and video-driven work.
Prior social agency experience or relevant experience with a track record of navigating high-volume, high-visibility accounts.
On-set and content production experience (domestic or international), including working with video directors, editors, and producers.
Performance-Driven Creative Execution : Deep understanding of paid media ecosystems, conversion design, and data-backed creative strategies. Responsible for translating high-level marketing briefs into high-volume, scroll-stopping digital assets.
Strong client presentation and communication skills - you can confidently present ideas, take feedback in stride, and advocate for great creative.
Excellent design sensibility and a strategic eye for layout, typography, motion, and branding. Additionally, deep knowledge of social best practices for optimal performance.
A proactive, collaborative mindset - you bring energy to brainstorms, jump in where needed, and support your teammates with generosity and respect.
A creative portfolio that shows your eye for design, your range in digital, video, and ability to turn strategy into scroll-stopping creative.
Multi-Channel Social Optimization: Strong track record in developing native short-form video content and paid ads, optimizing assets for user engagement and platform algorithm performance.

Work & Co, part of Accenture Song, is a global design and technology company with offices in the United States, Europe, and Latin America. We are known for uniting the industry’s best hands-on strategy, product, and technical talent to generate tangible impact at scale. As Fast Company noted, our engineering and design teams are routinely entrusted with creating digital products for companies that rarely approach outside firms. Forrester Research calls our approach “a model to follow.” Visit work.co to learn more.

Design Directors work closely with other Designers, Product Managers, Strategists, and Developers to create digital products and services that reshape industries while mentoring others in the Work & Co Design team. Our Partners are hands on and you’ll work directly with them — no middle management here. #wco

Stay 100% focused on making great digital products–that’s all we care about.
Work iteratively on initial concepts, prototypes, and detailed designs informed by user research, marketplace and behavior trends, and your best ideas.
Participate in a hands-on manner through all product phases, from strategy to launch to optimization (this job is not just about making wireframes or participating in one phase).
Lead and mentor a project team of designers

Deine Aufgaben Als Design Director (f/m/d) mit Schwerpunkt Branding & FMCG übernimmst du kreative Verantwortung für Markenauftritte, die Menschen im Alltag begegnen – im Regal, auf dem Display, in der Hand. Du verantwortest den kreativen Prozess von der Strategie bis zur Umsetzung – und sorgst dafür, dass Qualität, Timing und Wirkung am Ende stimmen. Wenn du Lust hast, in einem ambitionierten Team an Marken zu arbeiten, die wirklich zählen, dann bist du bei Mutabor genau richtig.
Markenführung & Design: Du konzipierst, gestaltest und verantwortest ganzheitliche Marken- und Kommunikationsauftritte im FMCG-Umfeld – von der ersten Idee bis zur Umsetzung am Point of Sale. Du entwickelst Designrouten und präsentierst sie überzeugend gegenüber Kund:innen, Kreativdirektion und Geschäftsführung.
Kreative Leitung: Du übernimmst die fachliche Steuerung mehrerer Branding-Projekte gleichzeitig, erstellst präzise Briefings für dein Team und externe Dienstleister:innen und verantwortest Qualität, Timing und Budget.
Teamentwicklung: Du leitest, anleitest und entwickelst Designer:innen, Junior:innen und Praktikant:innen – fachlich wie methodisch. Du motivierst dein Team, überprüfst Arbeitsmethoden kontinuierlich und sorgst für einen reibungslosen Workflow.
Ganzheitliche Kundenberatung: Du bist zentrale Ansprechperson für Kund:innen in allen kreativen Belangen. Du denkst unternehmerisch, antizipierst Bedürfnisse und entwickelst proaktiv Vorschläge – auch über das ursprüngliche Briefing hinaus.
Qualität & Prozesse: Du definierst Leistungsumfang und Projektkalkulation in enger Abstimmung mit dem Account Management. Du sorgst für Qualitätsmanagement sowie sorgfältige Ablage und Pflege der Projektordner.
Deine Qualifikationen Erfahrung: Mindestens 7 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich Markengestaltung und -entwicklung, davon nachweislich im FMCG- oder Consumer-Goods-Umfeld.
Branchen-Expertise: Fundiertes Know-how in Packaging Design, Brand Identity und Retail-Kommunikation sowie ein sicheres Gesprür für Zielgruppen und Markttrends im Consumer-Umfeld.
Führungskompetenz: Erfahrung in der fachlichen Steuerung und Entwicklung von Designteams sowie Freude daran, Wissen weiterzugeben und andere wachsen zu sehen.
Handwerk & Gesprür: Abgeschlossenes Studium im Kommunikations- oder Grafikdesign, sehr gute Kenntnisse in der Adobe Creative Suite und Figma sowie ein untrügliches Gesprür für Typografie, Farbe und Markenaura.
Kommunikationsstärke: Du präsentierst überzeugend, setzt dich in großen Runden durch und kannst Designentscheidungen klar verargumentieren – auf Deutsch und Englisch.

Not all heroes wear capes — but plenty of them use toilet paper
Want to challenge yourself at a purpose-led scale up AND make a difference in the world? Come join the revolootion!
Funny name, serious business
We are a leading eco-friendly household essentials business and we donate 50% of our profits to help everyone gain access to clean water and a toilet. As of June 2026, we’ve contributed over $20 million AUD to this mission. Basically, we’re really good at making it easy to do good.
We’re scaling our business across the UK, US, Australia and Canada, with our amazing team spread across these markets. Our 250+ people aim to make the biggest possible impact for people and the planet. Over the next 5-10 years, we’re hoping to increase our annual donation tenfold to get us closer to our dream of everyone in the world having access to clean water and sanitation services.

We’re looking for a Creative Director to lead our Marketing Design team (the people behind our limited editions, brand campaigns, social, lifecycle and promotions).

You’ll set the creative bar across two quite different worlds: the big, ambitious brand storytelling that makes people fall for us, and the fast creative work, informed by data, that keeps our growth engine humming.

You’ll lead two senior designer/art directors directly, and a wider team of makers day to day, coaching them to do the best work of their careers while keeping plenty of moving parts on track. Expect to spend around 70% of your time on creative direction and 30% hands-on, stepping into the work yourself during big campaign moments.
If you worked here this past month here are some things you might have been involved in:
Led a limited edition from concept through packaging development to full campaign rollout
Steered the social team toward content that’s culturally sharp, fun and unmistakably on-brand
Pushed the lifecycle team to create emails people actually want to open
Overseen a high-growth promotion from creative concept to launch
Coached your two senior designer/art directors through a tricky brief or a bit of creative friction

You’ve led both sides of the coin
You’ve genuinely led both brand storytelling and growth-led creative. Or, you’ve led one and have real curiosity about the other. You know these two worlds need different thinking, different pace and different leadership, and you can flex between them without losing the plot.
You’re organised, not just talented
Big ideas are the baseline here, but so is a genuinely high level of self-motivation, proactivity and organisation. If you thrive only with a lot of structure built around you, this probably isn’t your role, but if you can bring your own structure to ambiguity, you’ll do well.
You’re a self-starter with real creative ambition
You’re fast-paced, comfortable with a bit of chaos and you have the energy to see your ideas through to the finish line (and to bring your team along with you while you do it).
You give a crap. Do you want your work to make the world a better place? Do you want to work with other people who feel the same way? What a coincidence, us too!
Why should you work with us?
First off, as a certified B Corp™, we work to make a difference every day while maintaining the high standards of social and environmental impact. We’re in very good company with other exceptional B Corps around the world.
We also believe that helping to make the world a better place should be rewarded accordingly – that’s why we offer competitive, market informed salaries, meaningful support towards healthcare for our team around the world, generous paid leave, tailored learning and development opportunities, and free toilet paper (yes, you read that right).
Our engagement surveys (thanks Culture Amp!) tell us that our team is really proud (over 90%) to work for Who Gives A Crap and, well, we couldn’t be more proud of that.
Have you made it this far?
If you’re still reading, we think there’s a strong chance you might be our kind of person. Here’s the thing, though — research suggests that 60% of women and underrepresented folks might have already talked themselves out of applying. Even if you don’t check every box above, we want to encourage you to introduce yourself. We believe a diversity of perspectives and experiences makes a team stronger — and the stronger our team, the closer we are to delivering toilets and clean water for all.

About Scale AI
Scale AI accelerates the development and deployment of AI, from the high-quality training data and evaluation services that power the world's leading AI labs, to full-stack AI applications built for Enterprise, U.S. Public Sector, and Global Public Sector customers.

We don't just hand over a model; we find the highest-value use case, build the system around it, and own the outcome, whether that's an agent supporting mission planning for the Department of Defense, a sovereign AI platform for a government ministry, or an agentic workflow inside a Fortune 500 enterprise.

Ground the team in user needs. Build the research habits and cadences that keep your team's decisions rooted in what enterprise customers and users actually need, and advocate for that discipline with your Product and Engineering partners.
Shape Scale's approach to human-agent interaction. Scale's core value is human-in-the-loop AI, and the interface is where trust is built or lost. Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Join a high-performing team for an NYC-based custom apparel company
This is Crishel , the Creative Director at Fresh Prints.
I joined Fresh Prints right after college as an Artist. The job was intense. I was creating 16 designs from prompts… Every. Single. Day.
I could do it if you asked me to. But more than that, I wanted to understand how creativity could drive impact. I wanted to see how ideas moved beyond a design file and shaped how people experience a brand.
When I moved to the Growth Team, everything changed. It wasn’t just about making things look good anymore. It was about thinking like a marketer, contributing to strategy, and understanding how creative work connects to the business.
The turning point came when my manager, Jolijt, said: “Okay Crishel, you’re in charge.” After multiple attempts to find the right Creative Director, she decided to take a chance on me. That shift forced me to rethink everything. I had to unlearn habits as a graphic designer and start thinking about vision, systems, and people.
Today, creative work means more than aesthetics to me. It’s about how design serves the brand, how it makes people feel, and how it creates real value.
Now, we’re looking for creatives who want to do more than execute designs. People who want to think bigger, collaborate deeply, and help build how creative work scales at Fresh Prints.
If this sounds exciting, we’d love to hear from you!
Art Director
We're looking for an Art Director who's hungry to own the visual identity of one of the fastest-growing brands in the US collegiate space. You'll be the creative authority on what Fresh Prints looks like — from brand campaigns to pitch decks to product launches — and you'll work directly with our Creative Director to make sure every asset tells a consistent, compelling story.
This role isn't for someone who executes on what they're told. It's for someone with a real point of view, the visual chops to back it up, and great taste.
What You'll Own
Brand Identity & System
Lead the development and stewardship of the Fresh Prints brand system - color, typography, photography direction, iconography, and visual language
Ensure every asset, from a paid ad to a sales deck, is undeniably Fresh Prints
Build and maintain brand guidelines our team actually uses
Partner with the Creative Director to evolve the brand system as Fresh Prints grows
Creative Production
Lead art direction on brand campaigns, product launches, and marketing collateral
Hands-on in fashion and product photoshoots, from concept development to on-set art direction
Art direct and brief photographers, videographers, and freelance designers
Produce high-quality assets fast — from quick social graphics to polished campaigns
Maintain a quality bar that makes everything feel crafted, not thrown together
Creative Standards & Collaboration
Set and uphold the visual bar for everything that leaves the Creative team
Give specific, actionable creative feedback that improves the work without demoralizing the people making it
Collaborate closely with our Creative Director, Brand, and Marketing teams to ensure visual work serves the business
Represent the brand visually in cross-functional projects

You have a strong opinion about what looks good and you can defend it clearly without being precious about it
You have strong design fundamentals. You understand type, hierarchy, color, and layout at a level beyond personal taste
You understand, respect, and love the customers — you know that your job is to design for them , not design in general.
You think in systems, not just one-offs. Beautiful individual assets that don't cohere into a brand aren't good enough
You give feedback that makes people's work better, not just your vision real
You're fast. You know the difference between "good enough to move" and "not good enough," and you move accordingly
You've actually been responsible for a brand's visual identity before, not just individual executions inside one

At least 4 to 6 years of design or art direction experience, including meaningful time spent in-house at a brand (not only at agencies)
Experience owning a corporate or consumer brand identity end-to-end
Mastery of Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign)
Figma fluency for collaborative design and handoff
Strong typography, layout, and photography direction instincts
A portfolio that demonstrates both conceptual range and executional consistency
Experience briefing and directing external creative vendors and freelancers
Comfort working directly with senior leadership on high-stakes work

Mentimeter is an engagement tool with a clear goal in mind. To turn presentations into conversations. Through real-time interactivity and clear visualizations, we get people to participate, engage and become more productive. Transforming all those passive meetings, airless classrooms and drawn out trainings into valuable and memorable moments.
We truly believe that you achieve the best results by doing things together. And that successful leaders need to adopt a curious and collaborative mindset in order to get there. So with you at Mentimeter, you’ll be a big part of the ambition to help over 1 billion people listen, learn and work better together.

As Design Director for our Engagement Tools and Insights area, you will own parts of the core experience that hundreds of millions of people rely on to turn passive audiences into active participants. This is a role for a design leader who sets direction by shaping the work, not only by managing it.
You will join a product company at a pivotal moment. As Mentimeter evolves from a single tool into an integrated Engagement Suite, the hardest and most valuable design problems now live at the seams, where journeys span areas and coherence is a competitive advantage.

You will operate in two primary contexts: within your Product Area Leadership, where the work happens alongside the Product Director and Engineering Director, and within the Design Leadership Team, partnering the Chief Design Officer and fellow Design leaders.

You will define the experience direction for your areas and make sure design decisions translate into measurable customer and business impact.
You will report to the Chief Design Officer.

We are looking for a design leader who leads through the work. Someone with the judgment to set a clear experience direction and the hands-on capability to raise the quality bar by shaping, critiquing, and making alongside the team.
You have led designers in fast-moving, product-led environments, and you have earned your credibility through the impact and quality of your work. You are as comfortable owning experience strategy for a product area as you are getting into the detail of a flow that isn't good enough yet. You operate as a true peer to product and engineering leaders, and you believe design is at its best when it drives outcomes, not when it decorates them.

Set the experience direction: Define a clear experience vision and architecture for your product areas, and hold the quality bar that makes it real.
Shape what doesn't exist yet : Lead the design of new AI powered products, navigating the ambiguity and complexity of finding product-market fit where there is no established path to follow.
Drive product impact through design: Own the link between design decisions and the metrics that matter, including activation, engagement, retention, and expansion.
Lead as a peer in the area: Work alongside the Product Director and Engineering Director to shape area strategy and roadmap, driving user and experience thinking into the decisions that set direction.
Own coherence across the Engagement Suite: Take responsibility for experience quality at the boundaries with adjacent areas, so journeys that span the product feel like one product.
Develop the craft and the team: Recruit, coach, and grow Product Designers primarily through the work itself, calibrating performance honestly and having the direct conversations that help people grow.
Raise the bar with your peers: Work with fellow design leaders to hold shared experience principles and a shared quality standard across the craft, giving and taking critique at leadership level.
Evolve practice through AI: Push how design understands, explores, prototypes, and delivers with AI, increasing speed and quality while protecting product thinking and craft.

8+ years in design, including mid-to-senior management experience leading designers in fast-moving, product-led organisations.
Proven track record of creating impactful product outcomes through design leadership and delivery.
High personal design capability, with a portfolio that demonstrates craft judgment and range.
A player-coach leadership style: credible with senior designers, and effective at developing them through the work.
Track record of setting experience direction and connecting design decisions to measurable product outcomes.
Strong business acumen and the ability to hold your own as a peer to product and engineering leadership.
Exceptional communication skills, able to align teams and stakeholders around a clear direction.
Practical experience applying AI to design exploration, prototyping, and delivery.
Not required

Since June 2021, frog is part of Capgemini Invent. We partner with customer-centric enterprises to drive sustainable growth, by building and orchestrating experiences at scale, while harnessing the power of data and technology. We’re inventing the future of brands and customer experiences by delivering market-defining business models, products, services, branding and communications.

Joining frog means you’ll be joining the “pond,” a global network of studios, each with a thriving in-person and vibrant virtual culture. frogs are curious, collaborative, and courageous, united by our passion for improving the human experience across our areas of expertise, while each bringing our unique and diverse skills and experiences to the table.

We draw on our global reach and local knowledge to solve complex problems and create innovative, sustainable solutions that touch hearts and move markets. frogs prize humour, positivity, and community just as highly as performance and outcomes. Our culture is open, flexible, inclusive, and engaging.

Working at frog means being empowered to meet the moment, and Make Your Mark on every project, in your studio, your community—and the world at large.

What you will be doing

We’re growing our team and are looking for a Creative Director to join the brand team in frog UK, part of our Creative & Design group. We are at the forefront of creating and defining global brands in the new era of AI and the role would combine creative excellence with exceptional craft.

Along with the innovation, data and technology teams within frog and Capgemini Invent, we sit at the intersection of technology and creative storytelling to help global brands reimagine what’s possible. Our approach blends strategic insight with creative vision, always driven by the belief that AI can amplify - not replace - human ingenuity.

Our Brand team is an incredibly talented bunch of hybrids, including people with a background in graphic design, typography, copywriting, 3D design, motion, animation, storytelling, visual craft and brand strategy.

Job Description

Tendril exists to amplify the genius of ambitious brands. We help category leaders, innovators, and creators bring their ideas to life through multi-dimensional brand expression — extending brands across motion, sound, toolkits and design systems. Our work enables people to truly see, understand, and appreciate the craft, thinking, and intent behind complex products, platforms, and worlds that might otherwise be missed.

An Art Director defines and oversees the visual vision of a project, shaping its aesthetic, mood, and storytelling language. You collaborate closely with Directors, Producers, and the Artists that you manage to ensure that design, animation, and technical execution come together in a cohesive, high-quality whole.

With a refined eye for craft and a strong grasp of visual systems, you balance creative intuition with practical execution, translating abstract ideas into clear visual frameworks that amplify each project’s narrative and emotional impact, and help elevate your direct report’s skillset.

The Opportunity
Manage a team of Artists through regular touchpoints, feedback, and guidance to help you deliver on concepts for projects.
Partner with the Director to define and uphold a project’s visual vision; guiding style, tone, and storytelling from concept through delivery.
Translate ideas and briefs into unified design systems and look explorations that inform every creative and technical decision throughout production.
Work hands-on in design, contributing both conceptual thinking and “on-the-box” execution to support layout, cinematography, composition, and animation.
Collaborate with production, design, and technical leads to ensure creative intent aligns with scope, schedule, and resources while protecting overall quality.
Provide constructive, empowering feedback to Artists and Animators, helping them refine visual language, craft consistency, and storytelling clarity.
Draw inspiration from evolving trends in motion design, film, fashion, fine art, and emerging technologies, using them to keep the studio’s visual language bold and relevant.
Elevate each project’s creative outcome by ensuring every frame contributes meaningfully to the story and embodies Tendril’s standard of visual excellence.
Come Prepared to Talk About
How you like to provide guidance, feedback, and mentorship to Artists to assist in their growth and development
Your approach to staying engaged in the craft itself for when you need to be “on-the-box”
How you keep your visual language fresh by exploring trends in design, technology, and culture and how you’ve contributed this research to the places you’ve worked and people you’ve managed
How you collaborate with Directors to establish a project’s visual direction

$100,000-$120,000

Creative Director

Instrument is a design and technology company. We build brands, products, and experiences that move businesses forward—by making the complex simple.

For over 20 years, we’ve partnered with companies like Google, ServiceNow, Uber, Eventbrite, and ŌURA, helping them navigate change, launch new ideas, and grow with intention.

Our work spans Brand, Marketing, and Product, but what defines us is how we work. We bring strategy, design, and engineering together from the start, moving quickly from idea to execution and refining as we go. We aim to do great work and be great to work with, because both matter.

We’re a collaborative, hands-on team with roots in Portland and New York and a distributed presence across the U.S. and Europe. We build teams around the needs of the work, staying nimble without sacrificing craft.

We value curiosity, perspective, and continuous learning, and we’re committed to building an inclusive environment where people can do their best work.

If that sounds like you, we’d love to meet you.

Great creative leadership starts with a powerful idea – and the ability to make that idea stronger at every step.

As a Creative Director at Instrument, you’ll set the creative vision for ambitious work spanning brand, identity and design systems, web, and digital experiences. You’ll lead from the idea outward: shaping the concept, pushing the craft, inspiring multidisciplinary teams, and building the kind of client trust that allows great work to happen.

We’re looking for an exceptional conceptual thinker and brand leader—a creative generalist with high taste, strong creative conviction, and the presence to bring both teams and senior clients along with a vision. Your foundation is in brand and conceptual creative, but your range extends beyond any one discipline. You’re equally energized by building a brand from the ground up, evolving an identity system, shaping a digital experience, or finding the big idea that connects them all.

Depending on the needs of the work, this role may span multiple accounts or focus deeply on a single client partnership. In either case, you’ll have the opportunity to build meaningful client relationships, develop a deep understanding of their business, and shape the creative vision across a range of challenges.

Set and champion the creative vision across projects, developing big ideas that are strategically grounded, distinctive, and built to extend across different types of work.
Lead creative across brand, identity and design systems, web, and digital experiences, creating a strong through-line from concept through execution.
Maintain an exceptional bar for craft and originality, pushing the work and helping multidisciplinary teams deliver at their highest level.
Serve as a senior creative partner to clients, confidently presenting and selling ideas, navigating feedback and ambiguity, and building trust with senior stakeholders.
Lead and inspire multidisciplinary teams, bringing designers, writers, strategists, technologists, and producers together around a shared creative vision.
Balance multiple projects and creative workstreams while maintaining consistency, momentum, and quality.
Contribute to new business and account growth by shaping creative approaches, identifying opportunities, and helping turn ambitious ideas into compelling pitches and expanded partnerships.

Significant experience leading creative at an agency, studio, or similarly multidisciplinary environment, with demonstrated ownership of the creative vision from concept through execution.
An exceptional portfolio demonstrating big conceptual thinking, brand and identity work, and a consistently high bar for visual craft.
Deep expertise in brand and conceptual creative, paired with credible experience leading websites and other digital experiences.
The ability to develop and recognize powerful ideas and evolve them into cohesive creative systems and experiences.
Strong creative judgment and the ability to push teams beyond the expected while giving clear, actionable direction.
Experience leading multidisciplinary creative teams and bringing different disciplines together around a shared vision.
A strong track record of presenting and selling creative work to senior clients, navigating complex conversations, and building lasting client trust.
Experience balancing and directing multiple creative workstreams without losing sight of the larger idea or quality of execution.
Comfort working with ambiguity and adapting your approach as the creative challenge, client, or medium changes.
A collaborative leadership style grounded in curiosity, clarity, high standards, and a genuine investment in helping others do their best work.
